name: Tower Unite
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The social hangout game of minigames, a plaza and your own condo. Installs the dedicated condo server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; ini=Tower/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/TowerServer.ini; if [ -n "$STEAM_ADMIN_ID" ] && ! grep -q "^AdminSteamID=$STEAM_ADMIN_ID\s*$" "$ini"; then grep -q "^\[Administration\]" "$ini" || printf "\n[Administration]\n" >> "$ini"; sed -i "/^\[Administration\]/a AdminSteamID=$STEAM_ADMIN_ID" "$ini"; fi; exec ./Tower/Binaries/Linux/TowerServer-Linux-Shipping /Game/Maps/C_Condo -log -nosteamclient -MULTIHOME=0.0.0.0 -Port={{SERVER_PORT}} -QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Tower Unite. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 439660) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# Condos, backups and TowerServer.ini are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-439660}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server looks for Steam's client library next to itself.
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so Tower/Binaries/Linux/
# TowerServer.ini is written once; the Panel sets the title, player count
# and tokens in it at every start. Admins, bans and condo settings are the
# owner's.
ini=Tower/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/TowerServer.ini
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ini")"
if [ ! -f "$ini" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[/Script/TowerNetworking.DedicatedServerOptions]' 'ServerTitle=A Tower Unite server' 'MaxPlayers=32' 'SteamLoginToken=' 'TowerLoginToken=' '' '[Administration]' '' '[DedicatedCondoOptions]' 'CondoAutoSave=True' 'CondoBackupsEnabled=True' > "$ini"
    echo "Made TowerServer.ini."
fi
echo "Installed Tower Unite build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server title
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be in the condo at once.

variables.name: Steam login token
variables.description: A Steam game server login token for app 394690, which the server needs to be listed; make one on Steam's game server account page.

variables.name: Tower login token
variables.description: The server token from your Tower Unite account, which lists the server in the game's own server list.

variables.name: Admin Steam ID
variables.description: A SteamID64 the startup makes an admin; more admins go in TowerServer.ini, one AdminSteamID line each.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
